t: Compact. Bottom-entry, delayed silent fill valve features top-rotating knob to precisely lower or raise water level by 1mm, avoiding the need to reach inside the cistern. Well-protected float avoids interference with flush valve. Brass nut and shank. Easy to install and clean.
b: Suitable for High & Low Pressure Systems
Fits Narrow Cisterns with Limited Space for Adjustment
Top Knob for Easy Height Adjustment
Consistent Flush Volume Under Different Water Pressures
